page: Microsoft Azure E4as_v6 is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the Eav6 server family. It is equipped with 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 2 physical AMD EPYC 9V74 cores, operating at a clock speed of 3.7 GHz. The processor features 32 KB of L1d cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of L3 cache. It includes support for advanced instruction sets such as AVX, AVX512F, AVX512_VNNI, AVX512_BF16, AES, VAES, and SHA_NI. The server is configured with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, though it is Premium Storage capable.

Benchmark results indicate strong single-core performance, with a stress-ng single-core CPU score of 3066.27 and a Geekbench single-core score of 2102.0, both placing in the top 25%. Single-threaded bzip3 decompression and text processing also demonstrate strong performance. Multi-core and multi-threaded operations generally fall into the average range, with a Geekbench multi-core score of 4783.0 and a stress-ng multi-core score of 6100.57. However, memory bandwidth is a notable bottleneck; read-only small block and large block memory bandwidth benchmarks fall into the bottom 25%, measuring 303.52 GB/sec and 37.9 GB/sec respectively. Software compilation with Clang and database operations also registered weak performance.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the E4as_v6 offers a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8:1, making it a resource-dense option for memory-intensive workloads that do not require massive parallel processing. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent performance for single-threaded tasks. Given its hardware profile and benchmark results, this server is well-suited for memory-optimized workloads such as caching layers, lightweight databases, web serving, and text processing pipelines. It is less suitable for large-scale multi-threaded compilation, high-throughput database operations, or medium-to-large language model inference due to its memory bandwidth limitations and lower multi-core scaling.
description: The Microsoft Azure E4as_v6 is an x86_64 memory-optimized server from the Eav6 family, powered by a dedicated 3.7 GHz AMD EPYC 9V74 processor with 4 vCPUs (2 physical cores) and 32.0 GB of RAM. It features no local storage or GPUs but is Premium Storage capable. Benchmarks reveal strong single-core capabilities, with top-tier performance in stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core tests, alongside strong text processing and single-threaded decompression. However, multi-core scaling is average, and memory read bandwidth is relatively weak, placing in the bottom 25%. With an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio, this server provides a cost-efficient profile for memory-sensitive workloads that rely on single-core speed rather than heavy parallelization. It is best suited for caching, web serving, text processing, and lightweight database tasks.
